product_attribute: web-scale scraping of publicly posted images to train a generative image model

passages.case_name: Example Plaintiff v. Example AI Co.
passages.text: The court held that mass ingestion of copyrighted images for model training may constitute infringement absent a valid license or fair-use defense. The opinion discusses scraping at web scale and storage of training corpora.
Intermediate copying for a transformative purpose was found to favor fair use under the circumstances then presented.

product_attribute: fine-tuning open-weight models on internally licensed enterprise documents

passages.text: Intermediate copying for a transformative purpose was found to favor fair use under the circumstances then presented.
Where the training corpus is used under an express license limited to internal fine-tuning, the complaint failed to state a claim under the asserted copyright theory.

passages.text: Substantial verbatim outputs of protected news text in paid API responses supported a reproduction claim at the pleading stage.
